item.title: From CPU to Network: A Record of Troubleshooting Application Slowness
item.description: 1. Symptoms The business side reported that the API of application app-a was slow. Looking at the logs, one particular Pod was slow, and deleting that Pod so it moved to another node fixed it. From the monitoring metrics you can see that the Pod’s CPU usage did indeed spike sharply.

item.title: Running llama-Architecture LLMs on CPU
item.description: 1.
